scheme_name: Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a construction worker registered with the board as a beneficiary
Must obtain permission from the Protector of Emigrants (POE) under the Emigration Act, 1983
Recruiting agency must be registered under the Emigration Act or possess a valid POE permit
Must have a valid passport with a minimum validity of 6 months and a valid visa
Future employment abroad must be in construction and related works
Benefit is payable only once per beneficiary
Providing false information will require repayment of the assistance amount with interest
Application must be submitted within 3 months after obtaining a valid visa
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of visa expenses for overseas construction work up to ₹5,000 per beneficiary.
